verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is scripting-first, and its CLI is the primary interface rather than a secondary API bolted onto a GUI. First-party bindings exist for C, C++, Python, .NET and Node.js, and the product is mostly embedded programmatically in other apps rather than used directly by end-users, so its full feature set (transform, composite, draw, montage, identify, etc.) is reachable programmatically. missing for 10: an explicit statement that the language bindings expose every CLI/feature capability, and independent corroboration of how complete the bindings are.
